label: Python migration drift (Django)
description: Django's makemigrations --check --dry-run tells whether the models changed without a migration, with the services database of jgates.yml. Comes in by evidence: manage.py; runs only where migration is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
